formulaBlock.normalization: 'Water (Aqua)' one entry; asterisk markers stripped (kept as provenance: * organic-type marker, ** fragrance-component marker). E3: Fragrance (Parfum) at 28; prominent = 1-27.

cleansingStrength.rationale: C5: Sodium Coco-Sulfate (3) is the alkyl-sulfate defining anionic with three prominent buffers (Cocamidopropyl Betaine 5, Lauryl Glucoside 6, Coco-Glucoside 24) and no reinforcing route (Sodium Cetearyl Sulfate 19 is C3a emulsifier-grade with Cetearyl Alcohol 15) -> moderate.
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: Alkyl-sulfate class is harsher than ether sulfate; buffers and lipids offset it under C5.

conditioningLevel.rationale: C2 met with lipids in place of the silicone: prominent payload lipid (Sunflower Seed Oil 11) + cationic guar (21) + fatty route (Cetearyl Alcohol 15) + humectants (Glycerin 4, Sodium Hyaluronate 10, Betaine 17); also W-RICH.
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: No silicone; oil and guar sit after Citric Acid and the fatty alcohol is part of an emulsifying-wax pair, so care could be bounded (moderate).

weightPotential.rationale: W-RICH (sunflower oil + cetearyl alcohol converging with guar) with a moderate C5 reset -> not limited reset; bounded residue -> moderate.
weightPotential.counterSignal: W-RICH present; three deposition families incl. a waxy fatty alcohol.

depositionLoad.rationale: oil + fatty alcohol + guar + weak refatter, mid/late list

persistence.rationale: cetearyl alcohol somewhat substantive; oil/guar light

resetCapacity.rationale: C5 alkyl sulfate with three buffers

weightPotential.whyThisBand: Converging lipid + cationic routes make bounded residue plausible; reset is effective.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: high needs W-RICH plus weak reset or multiple clearly persistent systems not offset; reset is moderate and routes are late/light. low would understate the converging lipid + cationic residue (W2).

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: CSA passes (Glycerin 4, Sodium Hyaluronate 10, Sunflower oil 11, Betaine 17 on E4 humectant list); no prominent E4 comfort route.

careDirection.rationale: Coherent humectant cluster (Glycerin 4, Sodium Hyaluronate 10, Betaine 17, aloe juice) plus emollient (sunflower oil, cetearyl alcohol) and guar; no protein/damage cluster.

formulaFacts.role: plant juice (not a humectant route, C2)
C3a emulsifier-grade fatty sulfate (paired with Cetearyl Alcohol 15): not a route
